[[Seed of Suffering]] is a [[Torment creature]] [[boss]] that can be found in the [[Domain of Fear]]. You will need to cross the bridge behind the local [[Resurrection Shrine|resurrection shrine]] close to the [[portal]] to the [[Gate of Secrets]] to find him. 

== Locations ==
* [[Realm of Torment]]
** {{NPC location|Domain of Fear}}

== Skills ==
* {{Skill icon|Barbed Arrows}}
* {{Skill icon|Crossfire}}
* {{Skill icon|Lightning Reflexes}}
* {{Skill icon|Prepared Shot}} ([[elite]])
* {{Skill icon|Troll Unguent}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Seedborn Flatbow]] ([[unique]])

== Notes ==
*Caution while engaging this foe is advised, as fighting will most likely take place on said bridge, leaving less space to maneuver but exalting the tactical value of a [[Ranger|Ranger's]] [[Trap|traps]] at the same time.
